notes.title: Toots of Love! Free February Update 💘 🎶
notes.notes:
Hey Tromboners!

February, despite being the shortest month, is one of the most important times of the year. Without February, we wouldn’t have time to celebrate the really crucial stuff, like Groundhog Day or Frozen Yogurt Day. There’s a lot to love this month, and that’s why we decided to make February “Toots of Love” in the Trombiverse. Toots of Love has many exciting features, including weekly unlocks for our favorite people in the world—Trombone Champ: Unflattened fans.  

The unlocks will drop on average, twice a week from February 5th until March 1st.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/67cebfbfdd9113ae24e4e640b55aee8bc092c10c.png
An Abundance of Music Awaits! 
So, you’ve conquered the campaign, played through the community’s best hits with custom songs, and now you’re faced with the empty void of existence. Don’t worry—we’ve got you covered! We have some amazing tracks lined up for you to play and challenge yourself with. We’ll be hosting high score challenges in our Discord so join in. 

There will be five new songs for you to master. Think you can handle them? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/fef231db39af50ce5016f0e30beb981e9572259e.png

I NEED MORE TROMBONES IN MY LIFE
Even though we’ve added a ton of trombones and unique sounds to toot with, the community demands more. “I NEED MORE TROMBONES IN MY LIFE!” We heard you. We’re adding some lovely Trombones throughout Toots of Love. And hey, if you can complete all the new songs, then you’ll unlock a secret, mystical trombone. So make sure your collection is complete, and get tootin’!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/13b72af037fd001ec2c5bb2a6bd4d98e93ae94ac.png

Vibes Are Good
Love is in the air, and so is a brand-new outdoor environment! We’ve refreshed the scene to create the perfect atmosphere–whether you’re here to vibe, perform, or just soak it in. 
But that’s not all! The audience is feeling the energy too, so they’ve dressed up to match the mood. Expect fresh threads, a new ambiance, and a setting that truly sets the stage for an unforgettable experience. 

Whether you’re enjoying Valentine’s Day or Singles Awareness Day, hop in and let the good vibes roll! 

Bug Fixes & Tweaks

Added Timed Unlock: "Cupid's Wild Picks"
New unlocks throughout February! 
Transformed the "New Year’s Outdoor Environment" to the "Valentine’s Outdoor Environment":
Added Valentine’s themed outfits to the audience
Added Valentine’s themed background banners and elements
Fixed a slight performance issue with the Outdoor Environment when the curtains are closed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/dbaee37c42faac99ed7e6c73de25ad12811bbd51.png

notes.title: New Environment, Custom Songs+ Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! We’re kicking things off with a brand-new, FREE content update for Trombone Champ: Unflattened. There’s so many juicy things we’ve packed into this update and can’t wait for you all to try them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/7a23ed9a08dd603886c3c932bcab371738c853b3.png

Custom Songs: Scan & Jam

We’ve introduced a custom song-scanning feature that automatically detects any custom tracks you’ve downloaded on Quest. No more fussing around in folders—just open the game, press a button and you’ll see your custom songs ready to play!

Plus, we’ve added a handy “Custom Songs” album to the campaign menu so you can jump right to those.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/300c599967a35b8fa74e232fb84e34cb8ce98eee.png

New Outdoor Environment!

Step out into a gorgeous, snowy landscape—all without freezing your lips! This fresh, frosty environment is available now, and is the base to a whole series of outdoor environments we’ll be expanding to.

New Trombones & Community-Favorite Sounds

You asked for it, and we delivered: brand-new trombones have arrived, including a much-requested community favorite. We won’t spoil all the fun—but it has something to do with beans! A new mythical creature has also appeared along with a new fish trombone!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/fce768b8a80654907fbc9ea422a34ff473c2fefa.png
Introducing “Pitch Assist” 

We’ve added a Pitch Assist option to the Settings menu, so even if you suck, your trombone playing won’t make you deaf. This feature is completely optional and won’t affect your high scores, so feel free to turn it on (or off) whenever you like. Perfect for streaming your best performances to the world.

Goodbye “Simplified,” Hello “Unflattened” Mode

We realized “Simplified mode” might have sounded too… simple and some players were ignoring it. So we renamed it to “Unflattened mode.” These maps were hand-mapped to really take advantage of Unfalttened’s VR mechanics to the fullest and some are some of the most fun ways to play the songs. Even if you’re a pro player, definitely give the “Unflattened mode” a chance!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/38705db562e33039d41375511239e61e58a362e0.png

Bug Fixes & Tweaks

Features

 Outdoor Winter Environment 
 New Environment with banners celebrating New Years
 Custom Songs Update 
 Custom Levels can be found within the "Bonus Albums" tab of the campaign
 New Free Custom Level "Punch Em"
 Delete Custom Levels button in Settings to delete any unwanted Custom Levels
 (PC Only) "Reload Custom Levels" button in Settings reloads your Custom Levels folder.


New Trombones 

 Koi Fish ("Finstrument")
 Chinese New Years Red Letter ("Lunar Tooter")
 Unicorn ("Uni-Tune")


Changes

 Renamed "Simplified" Mode to "Unflattened" Mode
 Added a shortcut to the store (just select the Gramophone!)
 Pitch Assist
 Audio is pitched slightly towards where the note should be to make the player sound better
 Change back button to bring you to the campaign menu instead of the main menu
 Dynamic Trigger
 Squeeze your trigger less to make your toots quieter


Bug Fixes

 Chicken Slide and Mouth Change in Shop.
 Fixed All 50 Cards Collected Achievement
 Fixed Leaf Trombone Paintained
 Fixed latency offset not affecting the visuals
 Improv zones now curve with the notes/lanes
 Fixed campaign challenges disappearing when backing out to the full map and clicking a section again
 Fixed only left lane appearing in free improv if it's opened before playing a song


If you want to help us test out experimental features (and we got some really cool stuff in the works) 

then please join the Flat2VR Discord.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185287/cd85673debb51879e7805a6e961b052457f19f08.png
TCU is also currently on sale. So tell your friends. Tell your family. Tell your landlord.
